breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The Agent did not address the inconsistency of applying ideal-gas normal-shock relations to water. It asked a generic clarifying question about which downstream conditions to compute, without flagging that water is not an ideal gas and that these relations are appropriate for air (gamma=1.4), not liquid water. The error from the incomplete prompt was effectively ignored.
